properties.text:
Find the teleportation crystal and escape the labyrinth, but beware: the [color=#ff6666]Minotaur[/color] is hunting you. Collect as many [color=#ccb558]Treasures[/color] as you can along the way. Capture [color=#e4adf0]Fairies[/color] and release them to reveal the correct path.

Controls:
[color=#ffff00]\[Arrows][/color]: Move
[color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color]: Release fairy

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color] to begin...
